items.a: Helix24 is a digital marketing and web development company in Kerala. We run Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), Google Ads, local SEO and Google Maps optimisation, and build fast websites, online stores (Shopify, WooCommerce and custom Next.js) and mobile apps. We also produce branding, ad creatives and video Reels.

items.q: Where is Helix24 located, and which areas do you serve?
items.a: Our registered office is in Kochi, Kerala. We work with businesses across Kochi, Kozhikode and Trivandrum, and run campaigns for clients in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC.

items.q: How soon will Meta Ads or Google Ads bring enquiries?
items.a: Well-targeted campaigns usually start bringing enquiries within 24 to 72 hours of launch. Results then improve over the first 14 to 30 days as the ad platforms learn which audiences convert best and we refine targeting and creatives.

items.q: How long does it take to build a business website?
items.a: A business website or landing page typically takes 2 to 3 weeks. Larger web applications, dashboards and portals take 4 to 8 weeks, with demos at each milestone so you can review progress.

items.q: Will I own my website, ad accounts and data?
items.a: Yes. Your website code, domain, ad accounts, Meta Pixel and analytics data are set up in your name and remain fully yours, whether or not you continue working with us.

items.q: How do I get started with Helix24?
items.a: Message us on WhatsApp or call +91 9048009044, email info@helix24.in, or send your details through the contact form. We review your current website and ads and send a proposal for your business within 24 hours.
